name: bank-gateway-lm-provider
displayName: Bank AI Gateway (Claude) for Copilot Chat
description: Registers Claude models served by the bank's internal API gateway (OAuth2 client-credentials, OpenAI-compatible chat completions) as language models in Copilot Chat, including agent mode.

commands.title: Bank AI Gateway: Set OAuth Client Secret
Bank AI Gateway: Set Gateway API Key (optional header)
Bank AI Gateway: Clear Stored Secrets

bankGateway.baseUrl.description: Gateway base URL, e.g. https://<gateway-host>. Chat requests are POSTed to <baseUrl><chatPath>.

bankGateway.chatPath.description: Path appended to baseUrl for chat completions, e.g. /v1/chat/completions or /v1/chat/completion (use exactly what the gateway documents).

bankGateway.tokenUrl.description: OAuth2 token endpoint used for the client-credentials grant, e.g. https://<sso-host>/as/token.oauth2 (PingFederate) or https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant>/oauth2/v2.0/token (Entra ID).

bankGateway.clientId.description: OAuth2 client id. The client secret is NOT a setting: run 'Bank AI Gateway: Set OAuth Client Secret' (stored in the OS keychain via VS Code SecretStorage).

enumDescriptions: client_secret_post: send client_id and client_secret as form fields (Entra ID default).
client_secret_basic: send them as an HTTP Basic Authorization header, like `curl -u id:secret` (PingFederate /as/token.oauth2, Apigee, Kong).
bankGateway.tokenAuth.description: How the client id and secret are presented to the token endpoint. If the token call returns 401 with one method, try the other.

bankGateway.scope.description: OAuth2 'scope' form parameter. Entra ID: api://<gateway-app-id>/.default. PingFederate: whatever scope the gateway team issued for the client (often required). Leave empty if not needed.

bankGateway.resource.description: OAuth2 'resource' form parameter (Entra ID v1-style endpoints). Usually empty.

bankGateway.apiKeyHeader.description: Optional header name for a gateway subscription key (e.g. Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key). The value is stored as a secret via 'Bank AI Gateway: Set Gateway API Key'.

bankGateway.extraHeaders.description: Non-secret headers added to every gateway request.

bankGateway.stream.description: Use SSE streaming. Set to false if the gateway does not stream; responses then arrive in one piece.

bankGateway.sendMaxTokens.description: Send max_tokens = model.maxOutputTokens on every request (Anthropic-backed gateways often require it).

bankGateway.debugLogBodies.description: Log full request/response bodies (prompts included) to the 'Bank AI Gateway' output channel. Local only; keep off unless debugging.

bankGateway.models.description: Models exposed in the Copilot Chat model picker.

id.description: Model id shown to VS Code (must be unique within this provider).

gatewayModel.description: Value sent as 'model' to the gateway, if different from id.

toolCalling.description: Must be true for agent mode.
